name: wealth-copilot-workshop
description: Workshop starter kit: Build the Wealth Copilot - a fictional Asset & Wealth Management data + AI platform demo.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace api" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace api && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace api && npm run test --workspace frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace api && npm run lint --workspace frontend
